chrome.label: Community guides
chrome.title: Build something. Share what you learn.
chrome.description: Practical guides to discovering Icelandic software projects, sharing your work, and contributing to the community on Naglasúpan.
chrome.intro: A place to start, whether you have a project to share, a skill to offer, or something you’re curious to try. Find your next step in Iceland’s builder community.
chrome.aboutText: Naglasúpan brings together people building software in Iceland. Discover their projects, show your own work, and help each other make progress.
chrome.correction: Have a correction or a useful example?
